title: Remote staff are disconnected from the VPN every half hour
scenario: A VPN gateway that drops sessions on a timer: a support case about sign-in words and DNS words that lives in a workload without a knowledge pack, so the engine has to refuse it.

events.title: VPN disconnects every 30 minutes
events.text: Our remote staff are disconnected from the VPN almost exactly every 30 minutes since this morning. After that they sign in again and it works. It started after the weekend maintenance on the gateway. About 60 people work remotely and all of them see it. Teams and the DNS inside the tunnel are unusable during the gap.

events.title: Re: VPN disconnects every 30 minutes
events.text: Hello, thank you. What exactly was changed on the gateway during the maintenance? Please send me the gateway version before and after, and the session or idle timeout values from the profile.

events.title: Re: VPN disconnects every 30 minutes
events.text: The gateway was updated from 9.1 to 9.4. The session timeout of the remote access profile says 1800 seconds. I do not remember anyone setting that, the profile before the update had no value.

events.title: Gateway release notes
events.text: The release notes of the 9.4 gateway say that a profile without a session timeout now receives a default of 1800 seconds.

events.title: Likely cause
events.text: That explains the 30 minutes: the update applied a default session timeout of 1800 seconds to your profile. Please set the session timeout of the remote access profile to 0 for no limit, or to your own value, and save the profile.

events.title: Re: Likely cause
events.text: I set the session timeout to 12 hours at 15:20 UTC. I will watch it and tell you tomorrow.

events.title: Re: Likely cause
events.text: No disconnects since yesterday afternoon, the helpdesk has no calls about it. You can close the case.
